we introduce DaMata, a robot-journalist based on an NLG pipeline architecture, which generates daily and monthly reports about deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon, both in Brazilian Portuguese and English, and publishes them on Twitter.

Robot-Journalism is one of the most promising Natural Language Generation (NLG) applications thanks to the high volume of structured datastreams available nowadays, which enables automated systems to report recurrent information with high-fidelity and low latency

daily and monthly Twitter news reports on Amazon deforestation
daily and monthly news reports about deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon published on Twitter
